note: Ground punch from in front of a man sitting against the fence. Up on his knees, his chest already driving forward: the fist comes back by his own ear, no higher - the mount's clip, played from here, wound it up over his head - and goes in short and straight at a head with the cage behind it.

keys.note: cocked by the ear, the elbow down and out under it
in straight at the head, the hips behind it
